title: Household: The Silver Mirror
template:
Morning sunlight streamed through the dusty curtains of the quiet hallway. I stood before the ancient, silver-framed mirror to adjust my collar. To my surprise, my reflection was wearing a [color_adjective] hat that I definitely did not own.

The reflection didn't mimic my movements, but instead started playing a [musical_instrument] with great skill. The room inside the glass looked like a cozy cabin filled with [cozy_item]. I reached out a finger and felt the glass pulse with a warm, gentle energy.

A small [small_creature] suddenly poked its head out from the corner of the frame. It let out a happy chirp and began to [joyful_action] across the bathroom tiles. This ordinary chore had turned the entire house into a peaceful portal of wonder.
